name: @emsenn/playing
description: Playing — the OUTSIDE boundary faculty over @emsenn/relating (renamed from gaming): where communicating is the meme MONOID (meaning, ≤_t, across) and knowing is the meme COMONAD (knowledge, ≤_k, inside), playing is the meme's *-AUTONOMOUS DUALITY and the CUT (outside, via the opponent). Its characteristic morphism is the binary interaction `Design ⊗ Design^⊥ → Interaction` — Girard's cut / the pointwise knowledge-join of two dual designs — where a Design is playing's own carrier: a partial charge-valuation over a locus tree of memes (Proponent/Opponent/Daimon/none ↦ potential/active/stable/absurd). The convergence verdict (orthogonality) and bi-orthogonal closure (behaviour) are the codomain; the cut is the corpus's spiral hinge (convergence-to-⊤ = gluing the game = closing animating's turn). It carries the full CGS + ludics + play-anthropology surface (character/sides, game/play/settle, interact, analyze, read-strategy/regime/flow/deep-play/rhetorics/lusory, embed-culture, design/dualize) as schema-first actions with carrier-$id domain/codomain, projected to CLI/OpenAPI/MCP/web from the single relating dispatcher. See dev/docs/notes/2026-06-21-playing-as-star-autonomous-interaction.md.
